name: Boyfriend for Hire
source:
Is there anything harder than going to an anniversary celebration alone? In order to avoid all the uncomfortable questions from your family about when you'll get married, Olive, your best friend, comes to your rescue and sets you up on a date with a man. The chemistry between you two could be cut with a knife, but how long it will last depends on you!

[From in-app]
translation:
还有什么比一个人去参加周年庆典更难的事吗？为了避免家人提出关于你何时结婚的所有令人不安的问题，你最好的朋友奥利弗来拯救你，并安排你和一个男人约会。你们两个之间的化学反应可以用刀割断，但能持续多久取决于你！

[来自应用程序内]
